The '''Yoribuunt system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Tharin sector/Legends|Tharin sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Yoribuunt]].
